title: KingFisher Charters
specs: Target species include snook, redfish, spotted seatrout, mangrove snapper, permit, tarpon, grouper, kingfish, sharks
Fishing in diverse habitats including mangrove forests, grass flats, oyster bars, reefs, and wrecks
Wildlife sightings include dolphins, manatees, egrets, ospreys, pelicans, and sea turtles
Trips accommodate up to three people; additional companions possible with extra fee

blurb: Guests fish inshore, nearshore, or for tarpon and sharks in Southwest Florida waters. Trips include fishing licenses, top-quality gear, bait, tackle, and a cooler with ice and bottled water. Eco-tours and private captain services are also available.
extraNote: Non-refundable deposit of $100 required upon booking · Deposit good for up to 1 year if rescheduling due to weather or personal reasons adhering to cancellation policy
